title: angelica trifoliolata
intro: Angelica trifoliolata, commonly known as Asian angelica, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae) and is native to East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Asian angelica include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating digestive issues, pain relief, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Asian angelica include volatile oils, flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
